SELECT * FROM ( SELECT IM.ITEM_CODE , IM.ITEM_NAME , DV.DIVISION_CODE , DV.DIVISION_NAME , SC.APPLY_DATE , SC.END_DATE , SC.STANDARD_COST_AMOUNT FROM STANDARD_COST SC INNER JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.ITEM_CODE = SC.ITEM_CODE AND IM.COMPANY_CODE = SC.COMPANY_CODE INNER JOIN DIVISION DV ON SC.DIVISION_CODE = DV.DIVISION_CODE AND SC.COMPANY_CODE = DV.COMPANY_CODE AND DV.STATUS = 'Y' WHERE SC.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} ) WHERE 1=1
AND #{search_date} BETWEEN APPLY_DATE AND END_DATE
AND (ITEM_CODE ILIKE '%' || #{item} || '%' OR ITEM_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{item} || '%' )
AND DIVISION_CODE = #{division_code}
